questions.q: What is the capital of Angola?
questions.why: It is one of Africa's most expensive cities.

questions.q: From which country did Angola gain independence in 1975?
questions.why: A civil war began at once.

questions.q: What is Angola's currency?
questions.why: It is named after the Kwanza River.

questions.q: Which resource is Angola's main export?
questions.why: It is one of Africa's largest producers.

questions.q: What is the official language of Angola?
questions.why: It is one of Africa's largest Portuguese-speaking countries.

questions.q: Which civil war lasted from 1975 to 2002?
questions.why: It was a Cold War proxy war.

questions.q: Who was Angola's first President?
questions.why: He was also a poet.

questions.q: Which rebel leader of UNITA was killed in 2002?
questions.why: His death ended the war.

questions.q: Who ruled Angola from 1979 to 2017?
questions.why: His daughter Isabel became Africa's richest woman.

questions.q: Who has been President of Angola since 2017?
questions.why: He was a defence minister.

questions.q: Which 17th-century queen fought the Portuguese?
questions.why: She ruled Ndongo and Matamba.

questions.q: Which 1987–88 battle was the largest in Africa since the Second World War?
questions.why: Cuba and South Africa fought there.

questions.q: Which oil-rich province is separated from the rest of Angola?
questions.why: It lies between the two Congos.

questions.q: Which party has ruled Angola since independence?
questions.why: It was Marxist in the early years.

questions.q: Which country sent tens of thousands of troops to help the MPLA?
questions.why: They arrived in 1975.

questions.q: Which dance and music style from Angola is popular worldwide?
questions.why: It grew out of semba.

questions.q: Which energetic electronic dance music comes from Luanda?
questions.why: It means 'hard bottom'.

questions.q: Which waterfall is one of Africa's largest by volume?
questions.why: It is on the Lucala River.

questions.q: Which giant antelope is Angola's national symbol?
questions.why: It was thought extinct after the war.

questions.q: Which ocean is on Angola's coast?
questions.why: The coast is long and dry in the south.

questions.q: Which seafront promenade is a landmark in Luanda?
questions.why: It was rebuilt in the 2010s.

questions.q: In which sport has Angola's men's team won 11 African championships?
questions.why: They are AfroBasket record holders.

questions.q: Which desert in the south has the strange welwitschia plant?
questions.why: It can live for over 1,000 years.

questions.q: Which national park near Luanda has beaches and wildlife?
questions.why: Animals were flown in by 'Operation Noah's Ark'.

questions.q: Which rock road with hairpin bends climbs the Serra da Leba?
questions.why: It is near Lubango.

questions.q: Which stew of palm oil, chicken and okra is the national dish?
questions.why: It is served with funge.

questions.q: Which Angolan cassava porridge is a staple?
questions.why: It is eaten with stew.

questions.q: Which crater lake region near Lubango has the Tundavala gap?
questions.why: It drops over 1,000 m.

questions.q: Which Angolan singer is called the 'father of semba'?
questions.why: He was also an athlete.

questions.q: Which town in the far north was the capital of the Kingdom of Kongo?
questions.why: It is a UNESCO site.
